category_edits.rationale: Scale each nonpadding input item embedding by 1 + 0.1*log(min(c, 5)), where c counts that item's occurrences through the current position in the supplied history window. This causal repeat-frequency feature may strengthen recurring interests while preserving learned embeddings, SASRec topology, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor already imports this SASRec class, so prediction uses identical feature construction without additional parameters or checkpoint changes.

        causal_positions = torch.ones((M, M), dtype=torch.bool, device=seq.device).tril()
        same_item = seq.unsqueeze(2).eq(seq.unsqueeze(1))
        repeat_counts = (
            same_item
            & causal_positions.unsqueeze(0)
            & seq.ne(0).unsqueeze(1)
        ).sum(dim=-1)
        repeat_scale = 1.0 + 0.1 * repeat_counts.clamp(min=1, max=5).to(seq_emb.dtype).log()
        seq_emb = seq_emb * repeat_scale.unsqueeze(-1)
